race.comment: Key lead-up for Thursday's Oaks. ICELADY (1) brings the best last-start form having chased home stablemate Saintly Dancer in the G1 Thousand Guineas. She'd beaten that filly in the Prelude prior and 2000m shouldn't be an issue off her latest run. Maps well and sets the standard. A lot of these come through the G3 Ethereal where DE ARMAS (3) closed off well for fourth in the Thousand Guineas and should have more to offer only fourth up. Getting to 2000m should suit. The Waller pair of THARWA (11) and YOUR COLOUR (5) were the big eye-catchers in the Ethereal and look right on track for an Oaks. Neither draw well and likely get a fair way back but look out late.
